text: Picked up #5400 (TOCTOU race in inspect_physical_path_containment, most severe of the findings from the earlier src/security review) as PR #5407, chosen via docs/05-roadmap.md's Security And Platform Seams MVP workstream + #34 being open/agent-approved. Fixed via openat()+O_NOFOLLOW descriptor chaining on POSIX (closes the race by construction: verifying and opening a component are the same syscall) and a merged single-pass walk on Windows (narrows but doesn't eliminate the window, documented honestly as such -- Win32 has no descriptor-relative-open primitive without native NT APIs). Fully verified locally on Linux; caught and fixed two real defects in my own rewrite via actual test execution (an ENOTDIR-vs-ELOOP errno gap verified with a standalone C repro, and a use-after-close fd bug). Windows side has never compiled/run anywhere -- adversarial review + manual full Windows Native Validation dispatch both running now before merge. New requirement RQ-CF-CONTAINMENT-001 added to docs/32.
